'''Garold''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was allied with the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] that relocated to [[Cademimu V]] and initiated the [[Cademimu uprising]] alongside governor [[Chornarov]]. A strike team sent to take control of the Cademimu missile batteries from Chornarov engaged Garold and killed him.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Garold the Dark One appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a challenge boss during the "Cademimu" flashpoint.<ref name="SWTOR" />
